title: Notification template file
description: The English texts of the notifications (decisions 0009 d7, 0022 d5, d6.2): src/domain/notify/templates/en.json, keyed by template id or word key. A template is a title and a body, plain text (no markup: the renderer builds it, as {orderCode}, {detailCode} and the time placeholders; lines separated by \n); a word is plain text. Placeholders are {name}, {name:form} (a word in a form) and {name#key} (a count through the phrase key#<plural category>, such keys being words here). Every other language is locales/<code>/telegram.json, the same keys flat (<id>.title, <id>.body), any key left out shown in English. See docs/reference/notifications.md.
